from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u069/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    if row_lines:
        lines = row_lines
        axis = 0
    elif col_lines:
        lines = col_lines
        axis = 1
    else:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    period = lines[1] - lines[0] if len(lines) > 1 else lines[0] + 1
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pattern = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (axis == 0 and r in lines) or (axis == 1 and c in lines):
                continue
            phase = (r % period) if axis == 0 else (c % period)
            pos = c if axis == 0 else r
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value != background and (phase, pos) not in pattern:
                pattern[(phase, pos)] = value

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (axis == 0 and r in lines) or (axis == 1 and c in lines):
                continue
            phase = (r % period) if axis == 0 else (c % period)
            pos = c if axis == 0 else r
            if (phase, pos) in pattern:
                result[r][c] = pattern[(phase, pos)]
    return result
'''
path=program_dir/'task-e684e861.py'
